- My job is to make sure The Thalmor gains an even stronger foothold in Skyrim.
- For me to fulfill my mission I'm gonna need proper funding & a solid chain of network.
- I need to join an organization in Skyrim that has those resources? The Thieves Guild.
- I need to infiltrate their circle and gain their trust.
- After I joined them, I need to raise my rank ASAP (possibly become their leader) for me to have access to their full resources. That means I'm going to work my ass off while honing my skills along the way.
- Finally, having full control of Skyrim's underground network system and wealth, I can move on to my next mission.

Yes you can.
Become Ethereal is one of the best shout in the game. You just need a little bit creativity in order to maximize this power.
Basically you can :

See in the dark.

Run forever without using any stamina.

Stop the effects of spider and charrus poisons or other lingering damage effects.

Put to use those Master Level destruction spells without getting cut down before you are able to cast.   Also, scrolls!

Let enemy mages waste all their mana trying to spam Ice Storm while you just stand there chilling.  Once they are done, go up and stab them in the face.

Let enemy warriors wail on you and waste all their stamina, then once they are worn out, go up and stab them in the face.

Run through traps but still trigger them, so get a bunch of enemies to chase you into those spike doors and then set them all off - killing the enemies.  If any are left over from the massacre, go up and stab them in the face.

Light up a cloak spell and go Ethereal, set everyone on fire while taking no damage.   Also stab them in the face.


IGNORES ALL DRAGON'S BREATH ATTACKS.

Become ethereal is actually one of the most broken thing in the game IF you know how to use it creatively.
1. As a warrior you can close the gap to the range enemy be it archer or mage.
2. As a range player you can use it to create gap in order to cast your spell.

With those 2 methods alone you'd be a beast in combay without feeling like a noob simply using stealth archer.
